Decisions on your 7 questions. D-1 Underlyings: NIFTY index options (nearest 2 weekly Tuesday expiries) plus RELIANCE and HDFCBANK stock options (nearest 2 monthly expiries); BANKNIFTY and futures go to backlog to keep the chain and pricing work to one index plus two stocks. D-2 SL (stop-loss limit) is Should for equity and options; SL-M is out (exchanges restrict it for options and it adds a second trigger path). D-3 Orders are single-leg only; the strategy builder shows a multi-leg payoff preview (up to 4 legs) as view only, each leg opens a prefilled single order sheet. D-4 Stale quote (no tick for more than 5 s while the market is open, or socket not live) blocks order placement: banner plus disabled confirm button with the reason, never a warn-and-allow.

D-5 The server simulates the market clock (pre-open 09:00-09:15, open 09:15-15:30, closed; MIS auto square-off at 15:20; T+1 roll that moves CNC buys into holdings) with a debug override endpoint and a debug screen toggle so demos and tests can force any phase. D-6 AI cards may carry action buttons (Open chain, Set alert, Trade this strike) that open the target screen with values prefilled; the user still reviews and confirms; chat never places an order. D-7 One-time F&O risk disclosure, acknowledged before the first F&O order sheet opens (stored locally, labelled simulation); nudges are soft warnings inside the sheet: limit more than 3 percent from LTP, premium total above 25 percent of demo funds, option expiring today.

PRD is in docs/02-prd.md. UX spec must cover: watchlist (live, stale row, long-press actions), stock page (thumb-zone Buy/Sell, market-status chip), option chain (ATM pinned + Back to ATM, ITM shading, column picker, expiry picker with Expires today badge, 200 percent text scale on 360 dp), order sheet (equity and F&O, lots to qty to rupee total, product picker, Market/Limit/SL, nudges, disabled confirm with reason for stale or pre-open), F&O risk notice, positions and holdings tabs with P&L summary, alert create + in-app banner, AI chat with card types text/quote/chart/payoff/table and action buttons plus Simulated not advice label, payoff and strategy builder (max profit/loss, breakevens), settings/debug clock chip. States for each: loading, cached-stale, live, offline, empty, error. Up/down never colour-only; primary actions in bottom thumb zone, 48 dp targets.

Budgets (profile mode, mid-range Android 360x800, 4 GB): cold start to first frame p50 800 ms, to cached content p50 1.0 s, to first live price p50 2.0 s; 60 fps with at most 1 percent janky frames scrolling a 50-row watchlist and a 40-strike chain both ticking at 4 Hz; socket frame to paint p90 50 ms; memory 250 MB with chain open. Market clock lives on the server with a debug override; lot size, tick size and bands come from server metadata, never hard-coded. Chain subscribes only to visible strikes plus a buffer.
